notes.title: [Big Update] 🌍 All Localized!
notes.content:
The whole game is now translated

Hi all!
Sorry for my absence, it’s been a long and exhausting process, but I finally finished translating the entire game! 🎉

Please forgive me if some translations aren’t 100% perfect. If you notice any mistakes, I’d be super grateful if you point them out so I can fix them in the next updates.

🙏 Thank you all so much for the warm support you’ve been giving me, it really keeps me motivated.
I’ll soon be releasing more updates with new items to decorate your world even further.

See you soon,
The Laba

notes.title: [Bugfix Update] 🛠️ Achievements, Workshop Feedback, and UI Tweaks
notes.content:
Hi all!
This update focuses entirely on fixes and polish to improve your overall experience, especially for Workshop users and achievement hunters!

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements:
🏆 Achievements should now work correctly!
🔹 Reminder: Make sure to launch the game through Steam for achievements to unlock properly.

notes.title: [New Items] [Bugfix] ⚡ Futuristic Vibes Update
notes.content:
Cyberpunk Style & Smarter Interactions

Hi all!
This update brings a bold new aesthetic and some key fixes to improve your experience!

notes.title: [Big Update] 🛠️ Steam Workshop is Here!
notes.content:
Hi all!
This update introduces one of the most requested features: Steam Workshop integration along with general bug fixes to keep things smooth and stable!

🆕 New Feature: Steam Workshop Integration
🌍 You can now share your custom levels with the community or download levels made by other players!

📤 From the Levels section, you can:

Upload your own creations to inspire others

Browse and download player-made levels directly in-game

📁 Downloaded levels are saved as local copies, so you can play and edit them freely!

🛠️ General Bug Fixes

Various improvements to stability and performance
Minor fixes to level saving and loading systems

I'm excited to see what you create and what you discover.
Start sharing, start exploring, and let the community creativity shine! 🚀


⚠️ Note: The Workshop is currently in beta testing . If you encounter any bugs, please report them so I can fix them as soon as possible.
Thanks for your support! 💚

notes.title: [Big Update] 📖 Book System & Main Story Dialogue
notes.content:
[b]Uncover the Past, One Page at a Time
[/b]
Hi all!
This update opens the door to the story behind Midori No Kaori, with new ways to explore its world and characters, plus a few helpful fixes!

🆕 New Feature: Book System
📚 You can now place books in the scene and read them!
Each book contains fragments of lore that reveal more about the world of Midori No Kaori.
Take your time, turn the pages, and enjoy the stories hidden within.

🌍 Reminder: Be sure to set your preferred language in the Settings menu to enjoy the full experience!

🗨️ Main Dialogue Now Available!

The Chef and the Delivery Rider now have their own personal dialogues, sharing memories, thoughts, and their roles in the bigger story.

These conversations are the first steps into the main narrative of the game, more to come soon!

🛠️ General Bug Fixes

Various improvements under the hood to make the experience smoother and more stable.

I hope you enjoy this first look into the deeper story of Midori No Kaori.
More mysteries await, happy reading! 🌸📘

notes.title: [Big Update] Dialogue System, Localization, and New Decorative Vases!
notes.content:
Hi all!
This update introduces a major new feature, quality-of-life improvements, and a few fun additions to bring more personality to your restaurant!

🆕 New Feature: Dialogue System
🗨️ The world just got a little more chatty!
I’ve introduced a new Dialogue System that supports three types of dialogue: Main, Side, and Review.
For now, only Side and Review dialogues are active, while Main dialogues are still in testing.

📖 These dialogues aren’t just for fun, they’ll help you uncover the hidden lore of the world and its characters. Keep your ears open!

🌍 Localization System
You can now switch languages directly from the Options menu!
It’s the first step toward bringing the game to more players around the world. 🌏

🪴 New Items:
🔸 High Vase – A tall and elegant decorative piece.
🔹 Low Vase – A smaller version, perfect for subtle details.

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements:
🔇 Removed the ring sound for ready dishes when playing at 2x speed, it was a bit too noisy.
🧼 Added satisfying sound effects when cleaning crumbs from tables!
🌀 Fixed general bugs to improve stability and performance.
🎯 Set a fixed framerate to keep performance smooth and prevent fans from spinning up unnecessarily.

That’s it for this update!
I'm excited to see how you enjoy the new dialogues and features, and as always, thank you for playing and supporting the game 💚
Let me know what language you'd love to see next, and keep an eye out… there’s more to this cozy world than meets the eye 🌸

notes.title: [Big Update]Mysteries of the Water 🌊
notes.content:
Hi all

Can you interact with them?  👀🐟

General bug fixes to improve performance and stability! 🚀

notes.title: [Big Update] Delivery & Custom Placement
notes.content:
Hi all!

This update brings major bug fixes, a brand-new delivery feature, and more flexibility in placing objects. Let’s check out the details:

1️⃣ New Feature: Delivery Guy!
A random delivery cyclist will now arrive and ask for a package,you’ll need to deliver it to complete the task! 📦🚴

2️⃣ New Placement Options:
Grid Snap Toggle: You can now place objects freely without snapping to the grid by using the button in the shop or pressing CTRL. 🔳
Trees can now be placed anywhere, even in front of your restaurant! 🌲🏡

3️⃣ New Item:
Bamboo Tree: A new decorative tree to bring some nature to your space! 🎍

4️⃣ Major Bug Fixes & Optimizations:
Kitchen bug fixed: No more dishes that no one ordered! 🍽️
Event system fixed: Events will now trigger in a proper sequence. 📆
Achievement fix: The 50-item placement achievement now unlocks correctly once you have at least 50 items. 🏆

Enjoy the new delivery system, more decoration freedom, and a smoother gameplay experience! 🚀

notes.title: [New Items][Bug Fix] Walls, Tables, and More!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Let’s dive in:

Wall Tables: Single and double wall tables, perfect for creating cozy spots by the window. 🪟

Characters now arrive in mixed groups, adding variety to the dining experience. 👫👬👭

Implemented an FPS cap at 60 FPS for smoother and consistent performance. 🎮

Let me know how these updates improve your experience,happy managing, and enjoy the refined spaces! 🌟

notes.title: [New items][Bug fix]Neon Nights Update: Shine Bright!
notes.content:
Hi all!
I’m excited to share this vibrant new update that brings style and stability to your restaurant:

1️⃣ New Features:
Neon Signs: Add flair to your restaurant with 7 brand-new neon signs to light up your space! 🟣💡
Decorative Menus: Place 2 new floor menus to showcase dishes in style. Perfect for creating that authentic, cozy vibe. 🍴✨

2️⃣ Bug Fixes & Improvements:
Fixed the time speed issue: Returning to the menu at 2x speed no longer causes irregular behavior. 🕒
Customer seating algorithm: Improved for Auto Mode,customers now prioritize smaller tables first, optimizing space usage. 🙌
Resolved an issue where dragged customers in Auto Mode would remain rendered in front.
Prevented seating customers at a table while it’s being edited during Auto Mode.

These updates aim to make your restaurant not only look better but run smoother. Let me know what you think!🌟

notes.title: [Big Update] Auto Mode & Steam Cloud Saves! 🚀
notes.content:
Hi all,
This is a big one! Two highly requested features have been added to the game:

1️⃣ Auto Mode:
You can now let your restaurant operate on its own!
Simply click the "ON" button under Auto Mode, sit back, and watch your restaurant thrive without manual input. Perfect for when you want to focus on strategy or just relax!

2️⃣ Steam Cloud Saves:
Your progress is now automatically saved to the Steam Cloud. 🌩️
Never worry about losing your saves again, whether you switch devices or reinstall the game.

These updates bring even more convenience and peace of mind to your gaming experience. Let me know how Auto Mode works for you! 🙌

notes.title: [NewItem][BugFix]Sampuru Showcase! 🍣
notes.content:
1️⃣ New Item: Sampuru Showcase
[list]
[*] What’s a Sampuru? These are traditional Japanese food replicas often displayed in restaurants to showcase dishes.
[*] How it works:
Place the Sampuru Showcase anywhere in your kitchen.
Add dishes to it to decorate and bring your kitchen to life! 🍱✨
[*] What it does: Adds extra foods to your kitchen !
[*] Important notes:
If the Sampuru Showcase has foods linked to it, it cannot be edited.
Deleting the kitchen will also remove all associated Sampuru showcases.
[/list]
2️⃣ Fixes & Improvements:
[list]
[*] Adjusted rotation and smooth movement during editing for better precision. 🔄
[*] Added the ability to rotate items using the "R" key. 🕹️
[*] Updated the keymapping in the Extra section for clarity.
[/list]
Try it out and let me know your thoughts—happy decorating! 🏯✨

notes.title: [Big Update]Chef's on Fire!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve reached the first weekend since launch, and I’m really happy with how the game is going. You’ve all been so helpful in finding bugs and giving great suggestions. Here’s a list of the updates:

[list]
[*] Improved table algorithm: now, based on the number of chairs, an appropriate number of customers will spawn.
[*] You can skip the initial text on the splash screen by holding down any key.
[*] Updated movement, now you can move with WASD and zoom in/out with Q and E.
[*] Added a chef in the kitchen.
[*] Added a new floor lamp: Tōrō.
[*] Fixed food-related issues: customers will now only accept the dishes they specifically requested.
[*] Fixed crumbles on tables: when a table is removed, the crumbles are also removed.
[*] All rocks are now categorized under "Others."
[*] Every level-up now brings extra money.
[/list]
Thanks again for all your support!
